theme: An open Saturday, three days out from Croatia.
greeting: Nothing's on the calendar today, Dan, and the girls are with you in St. Pete. It's the day the Halloween call comes due and the last Croatia bookings can finally close before the trip swallows the week.

needsAttention.title: Halloween: St Pete or Maine
needsAttention.detail: The decision is due today and it's a blocker — the Oct 18–Nov 1 St Pete rental and car both cover Halloween, and that booking fires while you're at sea in Croatia.

needsAttention.title: Close the open lodging gaps
needsAttention.detail: Still open: the Sept 19 night in Cavtat after the charter, and the Sept 20–22 St Pete nights before the kids' pickup. Both have to be booked from land before you sail Sept 8.

needsAttention.title: Confirm checked bags on the ticket
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows 0 checked bags, and two 55L duffels won't pass as carry-on. Verify on Eurowings Discover with the record locator and buy bags online before counter rates.

needsAttention.title: Lock sailing boarding + transfer
needsAttention.detail: Nautilus wants the Sept 12 boarding details and the Sept 19 airport transfer settled before the course week — it's on the board for today.

flagged.title: Care.com password reset
flagged.detail: A reset email landed yesterday — worth a glance to confirm you started it, not someone else.

flagged.title: Nomura project — Lubrano wants a call
flagged.detail: He thinks a real Nomura project is worth proposing but doubts Chie's budget, and is waiting to schedule with you.

flagged.title: C&C Sprayfoam estimate — $12,450
flagged.detail: A QuickBooks estimate for the Maine insulation, due Dec 31; sitting in the inbox to review, no rush.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and Labor Day promos — FT, NYT Cooking, Responsible Investor, boat insurance.

resolved.title: UN PRI call pushed past your trip
resolved.detail: You asked to reschedule the Conor Kehoe conversation; Kate confirmed and said to reconnect when you're back.

recipe.title: Chestnut and Pancetta Salad
recipe.why: The first autumn note of the year — chestnuts and pancetta warm the plate just as early September evenings start to cool.

tasks.title: Book the refundable backup car, Sept 20–Oct 5
Build and pack the travel larder bin
Buy EU plug adapters + a US power strip

acts.line: A clear, unbooked start — room to close the decision that's been circling for weeks.
The girls are with you in St. Pete through tomorrow's handoff; the day bends around them.
Tomorrow opens at 9 with the 15-minute Sunday review, so a look at the board tonight pays off.
